items.title: Dalmatian Seafood
items.summary: Grilled fish, octopus salad, and coastal flavors.

body.value: Try grilled fish with olive oil, Swiss chard, and local white wine.

items.title: Pašticada
items.summary: Traditional slow-cooked beef dish from Dalmatia.

body.value: Often served with gnocchi and a rich, slightly sweet sauce.

items.title: Istrian Truffles
items.summary: A gourmet highlight, especially in autumn.

body.value: Istria is known for truffles—try them with pasta or eggs.

items.title: Croatian Wines
items.summary: From crisp whites to bold reds, with local grape varieties.

body.value: Look for Plavac Mali (red) and Pošip (white) as a starting point.
